'''''The High Republic: Convergence''''' is a ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' adult novel by [[Zoraida Córdova]]. It was published by [[Del Rey]] as part of [[Phase II: Quest of the Jedi|Phase II]] of the High Republic multimedia project, on [[November 22]], [[2022]].
